newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - July 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - July 6.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The first sea water desalination plant in Ras al-Khaimah is likely to go on stream ahead of schedule in December, with more than 80 percent of the 105 million dirham plant already completed, the company setting up the plant said.
- Dubai's court of cassation upheld the death sentences of a UAE national and three Indians on drugs charges.
- Trading on the Kuwait Stock exchange soared in the first half of 1997 to nearly $19 billion, almost matching the figure for full-year 1996, an economic report said.
- The Kuwaiti government has sold its share in 22 local companies for a total of 778.6 million dinars, an economic report said.
- An Arab Banking Corp study said average UAE oil production in the first quarter of 1997 rose to 2.233 million barrels per day from 2.173 million bpd in the year-ago period.

- Former BCCI affiliate Union National Bank said it posted net profits of 37.1 million dirhams in the second half of 1996 compared with a total of 47.7 million dirhams over the previous five and a half years.
- A decline in world gold priced has lifted sales by five percent in the United Arab Emirates.
- An official study said the population of the UAE was expected to rise to 3.1 million by 2000.
